audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 is right — Diana's entire kill pattern (Lunar Rush dash) feeds Vex's passive fear-interrupt; 54.53% WR over 1643 games and both layers agree on Vex for all 7 chart rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Lunar Rush an R-dash ('the moment she R-dashes (Lunar Rush)') — Lunar Rush is her E; her R is Moonfall. Otherwise spikes are sound: level 6 Moonfall combo, first-item one-combo AP spike, late flank-assassin role.
audit.why: Riot kit: E = Lunar Rush (dash, no cooldown onto Moonlight), R = Moonfall (pull).

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 lint findings: Diana misgendered he/his across tldr, tradeGood, ahead, phase why, breakdowns and five report entries; two Do's/Don'ts bodies pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad; cooldowns field with no digit. The decisive interaction (Lunar Rush procs Doom's fear-interrupt; Moonlight resets Lunar Rush) is stated; cooldowns now carry Q 8s and E 22s unmarked.
audit.why: Deterministic lint output plus Riot kit cooldowns.
audit.corrected: All pronoun fixes applied, bleeds replaced with title-matched bodies, cooldowns given real numbers.
